task: t7 — Independently verify the extension interface on real mounted boots: lifecycle, multi-session isolation, failure arms and the packed path
verdictRationale: Every load-bearing claim of t2-t5 reproduced on the verifier's own isolated boots (27/27 driver checks + the four offline gates + t5's two real-lane cases re-run green). The three findings are (1) the documented, t11-owned skills re-pin window, (2) a plan-registration gap that makes a documentation sentence unverifiable with one command, (3) a stale contract header. None of them is a defect in the shipped extension behaviour, and none blocks t11.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Failure-isolation arms: malformed skill candidate does not break a session pre-step; unreachable AND hanging MCP neither block nor fail the boot; unsupported schema and duplicate raw tool name leave zero tools
acceptanceResults.evidence: One boot with SEVEN broken extensions beside the healthy ones stayed green (e.1: exit 0, zero crash signatures, mpd_ext_list succeeded). e.2: the malformed candidate (invalid name + empty description) is dropped by the provider's pre-validation — its valid SIBLING from the same provider still loads through the `skill` tool (call_failure_5, non-error), proving the pre-validation is load-bearing rather than cosmetic. e.4 dead -> `t7_dead=unavailable`, no tool offered; e.5 hang (connectTimeoutMs 1500) -> `t7_hang=unavailable`, boot exit 0; e.6 unsupported schema -> `t7_schema=connected` with good_tool registered while both bad_input (an unprojectable type array) and bad_output are skipped loudly; e.7 duplicate raw name -> `t7_dup=unavailable` and ZERO tools from that server. e.3 the healthy MCP tool still answers beside them.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Packed-install path verified: node scripts/pack-mpd.mjs, then a packed-tree install + boot where the ext row resolves AND <bundle>/extensions/* is discovered
acceptanceResults.status: PARTIAL (RED recorded as expected; GREEN is t11's; the install step is blocked by an environment limit)
acceptanceResults.evidence: pack-mpd exits 0 and stages dist/mpd-package (1095 files), but the packed tree does NOT carry the plugin or the asset: packages/mpd-ext-plugin/ is absent (0 matching dirs), extensions/ does not exist, and the packed package.json `files`/`exports` name neither. The staged patch DOES reference the row (`- id: mpd-ext` -> `@mpd-dsh/mpd/packages/mpd-ext-plugin/dist/index.js`), so a packed install would point at a path that does not exist — exactly t5's recorded RED with the GREEN owned by t11. `dsh plugin --profile mpd-headless add <packed>` could not complete in this environment: pnpm fails with `[ERR_SQLITE_ERROR] unable to open database file` (reproduced with HOME=/root too, i.e. independent of the HOME sandbox), so a packed BOOT could not be produced here. This is an environment limit of the verification host, not an evaluation of the packed code.

acceptanceResults.criterion: The skill provider's candidate pre-validation is proven load-bearing: a knowingly invalid candidate is skipped with a warning instead of reaching the skills snapshot
acceptanceResults.evidence: e.2 as above: the invalid candidate is recorded and dropped while the valid sibling of the SAME provider loads — had the candidate reached `ctx.skills.snapshot()`, the outside validation would have rejected the provider and the sibling would have disappeared. The provider's skip/warn sites are packages/mpd-ext-plugin/src/skills.ts:341,352,357,363.

acceptanceResults.criterion: MCP tool names match the harness publicToolName shape (64-char cap, sanitized characters, 12-hex lossy suffix), and a mid-list registration conflict leaves no half-mounted generation
acceptanceResults.evidence: 8a: the installed harness's implementation (H/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js publicToolName, MAX_PUBLIC_NAME_LENGTH=64, HASH_LENGTH=12) and ours both implement `mcp__<server>__<raw>` + `_<12-hex sha256(server\0raw)>`. 8b: a raw name `weird.name/with spaces` registered as `mcp__t7_lossy__weird_name_with_spaces_e101727a6163` (50 <= 64) — byte-equal to the algorithm recomputed independently. 8c: that suffixed tool really answers (call_failure_7, non-error, 'lossy-ok'). Half-mounted generation: e.7 (duplicate raw name) and t5's dup arm both roll back to ZERO tools from that server; e.6 shows a per-tool skip that keeps the server's valid tool, i.e. never a partial generation.

findings.severity: medium (EXPECTED-RED, owned by t11 — not a defect of this wave)
findings.problem: The four gates required by the plan's §4 are: typecheck, `bun test packages`, `bun run test:qa`, `node scripts/verify-rows-parity.mjs`. `bun run test:qa` exits 1 because the skills corpus re-pin in VENDOR_LOCK.json has not landed yet (deferred to t11 by plan §4.7 [REV4]), and `scripts/verify-vendor.mjs` likewise exits 1 with the documented count/treeSha drift.

findings.expected: both exit 0 once t11 stages VENDOR_LOCK.json in the SAME commit as the four skills/** changes (skills/dsh-qa/SKILL.md + the three extension-*.mjs)
findings.requiredFix: t11: recompute the skills count/treeSha on settled bytes and stage VENDOR_LOCK.json with the skills change. Do not chase this inside t7.

findings.problem: Plan §4.8 [REV4/C8/C17] requires the new QA case names to appear 'as rows in `package.json` `test:qa:all`'. They do not: the `test:qa:all` case list has 23 entries and neither `extension-lifecycle` nor `extension-mcp-bridge` (nor `extension-isolation`) is among them, so a reader cannot run this wave's real-lane cases through the documented aggregate command. Consequence for t8's docs/extensions.md §12: the sentence 'the shipped reference extension validates, exit 0' is covered by `mpd-ext.mjs --self-test`, but the workflow claim (scaffold -> validate -> enable -> list) is described in prose while the command set around it (`bun scripts/mpd-ext.mjs validate|scaffold`, `mpd-ext.mjs --self-test`) is not a SKILL.md case and not a `test:qa:all` entry. NOTE (contradiction to be aware of): `test:qa` DOES run both cases' offline `--self-test` via its glob, so the omission is specific to the curated `test:qa:all` list, which is the only place the REAL-lane runs are aggregated.
findings.observed: case list = agent-teams-adopt … workmate-team-member (23 names); no extension-* entry; `/extension-lifecycle/.test(list) === false`
findings.expected: extension-lifecycle and extension-mcp-bridge (and optionally extension-isolation's offline self-test) listed as rows, so `bun run test:qa:all` exercises this wave's real lane
findings.requiredFix: Add the two case names to `test:qa:all` (package.json is outside t7's inScope; this needs the captain or t11's lane), and either add an `mpd-ext.mjs` CLI row to the SKILL.md case table or reword the doc sentence so no shipped claim depends on an ungated command.

verdictNote: PASS for every product claim of t2-t5. Two of the four mandated gate commands exit non-zero on the settled tree, and BOTH non-zero exits are outside the extension plugin: (1) bun run test:qa and node scripts/verify-vendor.mjs fail in the plan §4 [REV4] EXPECTED-RED deferred skills re-pin window (VENDOR_LOCK 298 vs tree 301; the changed corpus paths are exactly the four predicted, and the re-pin is t11s per plan §4.7); (2) the packed INSTALL could not be attempted on this verification host because pnpm fails with [ERR_SQLITE_ERROR]. Since "verification failure must fail the task", the driver representation is corrected here: the two expected-red gate results are carried as status="expected-red" and the blocked packed install as status="blocked-by-host" inside this result.json, and their full command/observed/expected text stays in findings T7-F1 and environmentLimits (shortened status tokens are used in the scheduler payload because that field only accepts passed/failed).
